finding: Retained raw enumeration bytes and inline execution provenance do not together prevent later substitution of the provenance declaration itself. The declaration must also be retained as exact bytes and hash-bound before manifest acceptance.

runtime_handoff: Resolve and read each retained declaration file.
Verify the declared SHA-256 against exact file bytes.
Require deep equality with the corresponding inline execution object.
Reject reuse of one canonical declaration file by both methods.
Run the existing independent-execution provenance gate only after byte binding succeeds.

verification.method: GitHub round-trip retrieval of committed schema
checks: valid JSON returned by repository contents API
both primary and independent method declarations required
SHA-256 pattern constrained to 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
runtime deep-equality and distinct-file requirements explicitly documented

uncertainty: The schema alone cannot enforce canonical-path inequality, byte digest verification, JSON parsing, temporal ordering, or deep equality; those remain runtime obligations.
falsification_routes: Supply a declaration file whose bytes do not match execution_declaration_sha256.
Supply retained declaration JSON that differs from the inline execution object.
Point primary and independent methods to the same canonical declaration file.
Demonstrate a validator that accepts missing retained declaration fields under this schema.
privacy_boundary: Only repository paths, hashes, schema constraints, and abstract provenance controls are recorded. No credentials, raw authenticated outputs, private source material, or personal data are included.
